title: Check DRC
params.strict: Whether strict checking is enabled. The current schematic is uniformly in strict checking mode
params.userInterface: Whether to show the UI (open the bottom DRC window)
params.includeVerboseError: Whether to include detailed error information in the return value. If it is `true`, the return value will always be an array
